description: Create a Qwen Image task on RunAPI (remix image). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for asynchronous task updates.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

source_image_url.description: Public HTTPS source image URL (JPEG, PNG, or WebP; maximum 10 MB).

strength.description: Creative deviation from the source image, from 0 (faithful) to 1 (creative).

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: remix_image
